items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was with Charlie Smith the left-handed drummer. ... I have a picture somewhere of Charlie, and Ray and I.

ctx.x: And Dizzy’s Two Bass Hit in 1946 and 1947. Ray left the group in 1948 to form his own trio. That was comprised of Hank Jones and Charlie Smith on drums.
That’s right! That was with Charlie Smith the left-handed drummer. He was left-handed.
